categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Pacific Precision Forging Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing sector, focusing on precision forged gears and components such as automotive differential bevel gears, transmission combined gears, shafts, EDL (electronic differential lock) gears, synchronizer rings, clutch drive hubs, parking gears, electric motor shafts and differential assemblies for new energy vehicles, and high-end agricultural machinery gears. The company also engages in the production of molds and precision transmission components. It serves both traditional fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles, with a growing emphasis on lightweight aluminum alloy components and electric drive parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precision forging technology, including precision forming, mold development, heat treatment, and machining processes. It has established national and provincial technology centers and an academician workstation to support R&D. The firm emphasizes synchronous design and development with customers, enabling system-level solutions that optimize product cost and performance. It invests in equipment upgrades and process innovation to maintain high-quality standards and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global and domestic automotive manufacturers such as Volkswagen, General Motors, Ford, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, Toyota, Nissan, Chrysler, Fiat, Changan, Great Wall, Chery, Geely, JAC, SAIC, BYD, NIO, Li Auto, XPeng, Xiaomi, and North American electric vehicle clients. The company also supplies well-known Tier 1 suppliers like GKN, MAGNA, AAM, DANA, John Deere, Volvo, BorgWarner, Schaeffler, Eaton, Valeo, and ZF. Its products are used in passenger cars, commercial vehicles, new energy vehicles, and high-end agricultural machinery.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Jiangsu (headquarters), Tianjin, Ningbo, Chongqing, Shanghai, and overseas subsidiaries in Japan, Singapore, and Thailand. It exports products to North America, Europe, Japan, Thailand, and South Korea. The company is expanding overseas production capacity, including a new plant in Thailand and plans for a future base in North Africa to meet local market demands and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Pacific Precision Forging operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of precision forged components and assemblies that are critical parts of automotive transmissions and drivetrains. It collaborates closely with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, providing both components and integrated modules such as differential assemblies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes quality leadership and independent R&D, focusing on new energy vehicle electric drive components, differential assemblies, and lightweight aluminum alloy chassis parts. It aims to enhance synchronous forward development capabilities with customers, expand overseas production capacity, and accelerate new product development in electric vehicle and robotic joint modules. Continuous improvement in cost reduction, quality enhancement, and process innovation are strategic R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision forged automotive components and assemblies to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company operates on a product sales model with a focus on large-volume contracts and long-term supply agreements. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its manufacturing projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the precision forged gear segment for passenger vehicles in China, holding top positions in production and sales volumes for forged gears, combined gears, EDL gears, and differential assemblies. It competes with both domestic and international automotive parts manufacturers, leveraging its advanced technology, strong customer relationships, and cost competitiveness to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.025 billion, a slight decrease of 3.72% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 159.7 million, down 32.79%. Domestic sales accounted for over 71% of revenue, with exports making up nearly 29%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.09 billion, growing 13.37% year-over-year. R&D investment increased to RMB 125 million, representing 6.18% of revenue. The company is expanding capacity with new plants and projects, expecting stable growth in 2025 despite industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Pacific Precision Forging emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, synchronous forward development with global OEMs, and advanced precision forging technology to deliver high-quality, cost-effective, and reliable automotive components. Its global customer base and integration with Tier 1 suppliers demonstrate its competitive edge in quality, innovation, and supply chain responsiveness. The company’s strategic focus on new energy vehicle components and lightweight materials further differentiates it in the evolving automotive market.
